upgrade.text: The boring part first: fetch the latest package lists and upgrade all the installed packages.

hint.debian: Two steps with apt: `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt upgrade`.
hint.arch: A single command does both in pacman: `-Syu`, with sudo.
hint.redhat: dnf fetches the package information by itself, so `sudo dnf upgrade` is enough.

search.text: Alex is taking a course in the Go programming language. Search the package lists to find out what the package with Go is called in your distribution.

hint.debian: `apt search` looks in both names and descriptions – try `golang` or `"Go programming"`.
hint.arch: `pacman -Ss` looks in both names and descriptions – try `"Go programming"`.
hint.redhat: `dnf search` looks in both names and descriptions – try `golang`.

install.text: Install everything on Alex's wish list: the process viewer `htop`, the Go programming language and the text editor Vim.

hint.debian: You can give `sudo apt install` several packages at once. Go is called `golang-go` and Vim `vim`.
hint.arch: You can give `sudo pacman -S` several packages at once. Go is called `go` and Vim `vim`.
hint.redhat: You can give `sudo dnf install` several packages at once. Go is called `golang`, and Vim is called `vim-enhanced` in the Red Hat family.

list-installed.text: Double-check: look up Go in the list of **installed** packages.

hint.debian: `apt list --installed` lists every installed package. Pass the list on to `grep` so you don't have to search.
hint.arch: `pacman -Q` lists every installed package – or just the packages you write after it.
hint.redhat: `dnf list --installed` lists every installed package. Pass the list on to `grep` so you don't have to search.

remove.text: Alex tried Vim and couldn't find the way out. "Get rid of it!" Uninstall Vim.

hint.debian: `sudo apt remove` and the package's name.
hint.redhat: `sudo dnf remove` and the package's name – the same name as when you installed it.

vlc.text: Alex wants to watch films. Install the media player VLC (`org.videolan.VLC`) as a Flatpak from Flathub.

hint.debian: `flatpak install flathub org.videolan.VLC`. Flatpak or Flathub missing? Install the package `flatpak` and add Flathub with `flatpak remote-add`.
hint.arch: `flatpak install flathub org.videolan.VLC`. Flatpak or Flathub missing? Install the package `flatpak` and add Flathub with `flatpak remote-add`.
hint.redhat: `flatpak install flathub org.videolan.VLC`. Flathub missing? Add it with `flatpak remote-add`.

go-version.text: A test run before you hand the laptop back: let Go show its version, so Alex can see that the course can begin.
go-version.hint: The program is called `go`, and the subcommand `version` prints the version.
